description: Attack-set row that groups an ordered list of AttackDataTable IDs for a character's attack chain and stores range, cursed-energy, inertia and recovery metadata for that chain.

Id.technical: FName row key; export label ID. Action objects select a set ID from the owning character's action row (many Id_AttackSet_* fields, sometimes variant-specific such as the CN_041 Solo flag) and call Action_FindAttackSetRow over AttackSetDataTables, which returns the first row holding the ID; bCheckNone is commonly true. Some controllers cache the pointer (for example HeldAttackSetRow), and the command-list widget resolves a set by an explicitly supplied ID. This is a single unsharded table.

AttackRangeType.simple: Whether this attack chain is short-range or long-range.
AttackRangeType.technical: EGameAttackRangeType (None, Short, Long, Invalid=255). On attack start with StartCount <= 0, Short records battle-log value 0x3F and calls OnCharacterShortRangeAttack; Long records 0x40 and calls OnCharacterLongRangeAttack. Other values do nothing. This classification is separate from any per-attack range and is emitted once per chain start.

bCursedEnergyAttack.simple: Marks this chain as a cursed-energy attack for mission/stat tracking.
bCursedEnergyAttack.technical: bool checked once on chain start (StartCount <= 0). When true it adds battle-log value 9, additionally 0xE for cursed-energy-attack-1 actions or 0x13 for cursed-energy-attack-2 actions, calls OnCharacterCursedEnergyAttack, and calls OnCharacterCursedEnergyAttackLevelMax when the current cursed-energy level is at least 3. It does not itself choose the Attack row's CursedEnergyCalcType.

bRecoverCursedEnergyDisabled.simple: Suppresses cursed-energy recovery during this attack chain.
bRecoverCursedEnergyDisabled.technical: bool. FGameCharacterAction_AttackBase::GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate and GetCursedEnergyRecoveryWaitRate each return 0.0f while the cached AttackSetRow has this flag true, otherwise 1.0f (both are active slot overrides). Null AttackSetRow also yields 1.0f.

Inherit_Inertia_Rate.simple: XY inertia multiplier carried into the attack start.
Inherit_Inertia_Rate.technical: float passed as RateXY to UGameActorMovementController::ScaleInertia on chain start. If the active XY inertia interpolation FloatInterp228 is active, its current value is multiplied by this rate and a new interpolation is restarted over the remaining duration with the same ease. No effect when that interpolation is inactive; Z uses Inherit_Inertia_RateZ instead.

Inherit_Inertia_RateZ.simple: Vertical inertia multiplier carried into the attack start.
Inherit_Inertia_RateZ.technical: float. On chain start it first scales the active jump-inertia carry interpolation (UGameCharacterMovementController::ScaleJumpInertiaCarry multiplies its current value) and is then passed as RateZ to ScaleInertia, which rescales the active FloatInterp258. Both rescalings preserve remaining time and ease type; inactive interpolations are untouched.

Id_Attack.simple: Ordered list of AttackDataTable row IDs comprising the chain steps.
Id_Attack.technical: TArray<FName>. FGameCharacterAction_AttackBase::GetAttackRow(SetRow, Index) bounds-checks Index against Num(), skips None, then scans AttackDataTables in order for the first matching Attack row; Start passes GetActionStartCount() as Index. Other consumers read [0] directly (CP_160 condition helper) or iterate all IDs to sum cursed-energy costs (command-list widget, skipping None and near-zero CursedEnergy_Add). Export rows contain 12 slots; trailing None entries are valid and simply yield null rows. Cross-table join: AttackSetDataTable -> AttackDataTable.

notes: AGameDataTableManager::Tick resolves only AttackSetDataTable into AttackSetDataTables (Source/Abrams/Private/GameDataTableManager.cpp:228, Source/Abrams/Public/GameDataTableManager.h:139). Action_FindAttackSetRow is the shared first-match finder declared at Source/Abrams/Public/GameDataTableManager.h:49.

The base GetAttackSetRow virtual uses the owner action row's Id_AttackSet_Normal_1; many CN_*/CP_* action classes override it to select other Id_AttackSet_* fields (for example the CN_041 air normal attack's Solo variant) or cache the chosen row. All feed the same row struct and fields documented here.
Missing AttackSetRow aborts the attack action (Phase=MAX_int32, Byte16=1) when GetAttackRow returns null, so Id_Attack values must resolve for a chain to play.

Exported arrays use 12 fixed slots with trailing None; the runtime consumer is length-agnostic and skips None. No numbered shards or localization variants were identified, and partial Content prevents excluding Blueprint-only users.
Evidence is reconstructed retail-behaviour C++ plus serialized export schema; exported values are not used as semantic proof.

usages.detail: Attack action Start resolves AttackSetRow and the indexed AttackRow, then applies range tracking, cursed-energy tracking and inertia scaling.
GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate/GetCursedEnergyRecoveryWaitRate return 0 when the set disables cursed-energy recovery.
GetAttackRow joins Id_Attack[Index] into AttackDataTables with bounds and None checks.
Representative override choosing a Solo/non-Solo action-row ID before calling Action_FindAttackSetRow.
AI/condition helper resolves a set by ID and reads its first attack row.
Command-list text iterates Id_Attack and sums scaled cursed-energy costs from the joined Attack rows.
